title: Euclidean growth of a sum of weighted parallel n-planes bounds its total weight by 1
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace with dim V = n (Module.finrank ℝ V = n), let Z ⊆ V^⊥ be any set and a : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] any function, and let ν = Σ_{w∈Z} a(w)·Hⁿ⌞{y : y − w ∈ V} (Measure.sum indexed by the subtype Z; Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Assume ν(B_R(0)) ≤ ω_n·ofReal(Rⁿ) for every R > 0 (B_R(0) the open ball, ω_n = unitBallVolume n). Then Σ'_{w∈Z} a(w) ≤ 1, the unconditional sum (tsum) over the subtype Z being taken in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (Z : Set (Euclid P)) (a : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), Module.finrank ℝ V = n → Z ⊆ (Vᗮ : Set (Euclid P)) → ν = Measure.sum (fun w : Z => a w • (μHE[n]).restrict {y : Euclid P | y - w ∈ V}) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ν (ball 0 R) ≤ unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ n)) → ∑' w : Z, a w ≤ 1
